## Sales Trend Snapshot: Jan–Jun

**Dataset:** Jan 120, Feb 150, Mar 130, Apr 180, May 210, Jun 190
This is a short monthly time series, so the clearest dashboard view is one that shows trend, month-to-month change, and a simple KPI summary.

## Best Dashboard Charts for Manager Review

| Chart Type | Best Use | Why It Fits This Dataset |
|---|---|---|
| Line chart | Monthly trend | Shows the overall upward movement and the dip in March and June clearly |
| Column chart | Month-by-month comparison | Makes it easy to compare each month’s sales at a glance |
| KPI cards | Current performance | Highlights total, average, peak month, and latest month quickly |
| Waterfall chart | Month-over-month change | Useful if the manager wants to see gains and drops between months |
| Small sparkline | Compact summary tile | Good for a header area or executive overview |

## Key Business Insights

- **Overall growth is strong:** sales rose from **120 in January to 190 in June**, a net increase of **70** or about **58%**.
- **May is the peak month:** **210** is the highest value, suggesting a strong campaign, seasonality, or one-time lift worth investigating.
- **Momentum is uneven:** there are two pullbacks, in **March (130)** and **June (190)**, so the trend is positive but not fully steady.

## Two Practical Dashboard Layouts

### Layout 1: Executive Summary
- Top row: **Total Sales**, **Average Sales**, **Peak Month**, **Latest Month**
- Main panel: **Line chart** for Jan–Jun trend
- Side panel: **Month-over-month change** as a small bar or waterfall chart
- Best for: quick manager review and weekly/monthly check-ins

### Layout 2: Performance Review Dashboard
- Top row: **KPI cards**
- Left panel: **Column chart** by month
- Right panel: **Line chart** with a 3-month moving trend
- Bottom panel: short **insight notes** and variance flags
- Best for: discussing performance drivers and variance explanations

## Quick Actions

Action: [Button: Build Trend View](https://www.google.com/search?q=dashboard+line+chart+monthly+sales+best+practices)
Action: [Button: Compare Chart Types](https://www.google.com/search?q=bar+chart+vs+line+chart+for+monthly+sales+dashboard)

## Sources

- Chart selection guidance: https://www.tableau.com/learn/articles/data-visualization
- Dashboard design basics: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-bi/create-reports/service-dashboards
- Time-series chart best practices: https://www.data-to-viz.com/graph/line.html
